chief_complaint: new severe headache, scalp tenderness, and jaw pain when chewing
hpi_details: 75F presents with a 2-week history of a constant right-sided temporal headache. She notes it hurts to brush her hair. When she eats steak, her jaw gets very tired and painful. She also had an episode of brief vision loss in her right eye yesterday.

investigation_events.title: STAT inflammatory-marker results
investigation_events.availability_message: The STAT inflammatory markers are now available; threatened vision requires treatment without waiting for imaging or biopsy.

core_concepts: Large vessel vasculitis affecting branches of the carotid artery, predominantly in older adults.
Jaw claudication and amaurosis fugax (vision loss) are highly specific.
common_misconceptions: Waiting for temporal artery biopsy results before starting steroids.
dangerous_errors: Delaying high-dose corticosteroids, leading to permanent irreversible blindness.
management_principles: Start high-dose corticosteroids immediately if suspected, before biopsy; use intravenous methylprednisolone when there is threatened or established visual loss. Check ESR/CRP.
boundaries_and_exceptions: Specific drug dosages, monitoring protocols, and referral criteria must be tailored to organ function, comorbidities, and local hospital pathways.
Atypical presentations in elderly, pediatric, or immunocompromised patients may require lower thresholds for inpatient monitoring and specialist consultation.

source_refs.title: American College of Rheumatology (ACR) Clinical Guidance

reference_soap.subjective: 75F with new temporal headache, scalp tenderness, jaw claudication, and amaurosis fugax.
reference_soap.objective: Right temporal artery is prominent, firm, and tender. No pulses on the right.
reference_soap.plan: STAT ESR and CRP. Because she has transient visual loss, start intravenous methylprednisolone immediately to prevent permanent blindness. Arrange urgent temporal artery biopsy.

learning_objectives: Identify the signs of GCA and understand the critical need for immediate steroid therapy.

teaching.one_liner: An elderly female with temporal headache, jaw claudication, and vision changes requiring emergent steroids.

must_ask.say: Is the headache on one side, and does it hurt to touch your scalp?
Does your jaw get tired or painful when you chew, like when eating meat?
Have you had any episodes of blurred vision or vision loss?
Have you had any aching or stiffness in your shoulders or hips?
When did the headache start, and when did the vision loss happen?
